title: The wolf with the torn ear: {name}
Coin on a wolf's head
summary: A great wolf is taking the shepherds' lambs {direction} of {settlement}, {distance} out: {name}. The hunters have put coin on her head.
offer: She's bigger than any dog and cleverer than most men. Three times we've had her in sight and three times she's gone. {name}, the shepherds call her. {distance} {direction} of here, by the last tracks. Bring her down.
progress: Another lamb gone last night. She's laughing at us.
complete: That pelt will hang in the lodge for years. Here, your share, and well earned.
